data.critFlavor: What is this power that corrupts even the pillars of the world, the almighty Olympians? Or... were they never that to begin with...?

data.name: Sanctified Effigy

data.critFlavor: For this is but a Descendant and the real thing is still much revered. End its reign!

data.name: Substructural Stone Plating
data.critFlavor: Each hit chinks the fortified stone -- and if the Staircase truly is endless, you'll make yourself a ladder!

data.critFlavor: You rip off one of the Burden's mechanical legs! It still moves as if it had a mind of its own
